settings.text: Choose your build and add it to your cart.
Pick Affirm at checkout and select your monthly terms.
Get a quick decision — ride now, pay over time.
Start the quick Truemed eligibility check.
If eligible, receive a Letter of Medical Necessity.
Pay with your HSA/FSA card — or reimburse yourself, pre-tax.

settings.question: Can I really use my HSA/FSA on a bike?
settings.answer: In many cases, yes. Truemed evaluates eligibility and, where appropriate, issues a Letter of Medical Necessity so you can use pre-tax funds. Eligibility is individual — Truemed confirms it.

settings.question: What happens at checkout?
settings.answer: Choose Affirm to pay monthly, or use your HSA/FSA card after completing Truemed's eligibility step. Standard returns still apply.

settings.question: Is the monthly estimate a quote?
settings.answer: No. On-page figures are illustrative. Your real rate and terms come from Affirm at checkout.

settings.heading: Ride now, pay monthly — or use pre-tax dollars.
